questions.prompt:
Official NSC · Nov 2022 · Geography Paper 1 · Question 1.1

Midlatitude cyclones in South Africa are associated with …
questions.explanation: Cut-off lows / midlatitude systems often bring frontal rain and strong winds.

questions.prompt:
Official NSC · Nov 2022 · Geography Paper 1 · Question 2.1

Name the fluvial process that involves the wearing away of river banks and beds.
questions.explanation: Erosion removes material from the channel; abrasion is a common mechanism.
